preconditions.description: The number of strings in the array a is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The minimum number of strings that a substring must be a part of is at least 1 and at most n.
Each string ai in the array a has a length between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: The total length of all strings ai does not exceed 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all strings ai in the array a does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: The output is a list of n integers, where the i-th integer is the number of pairs (l, r) such that the substring ai[l... r] is a substring of at least k strings from the array a.
postconditions.description: The output must correctly count the number of such pairs for each string ai.
